title: Fleet host runs fleet-agent 1.380.1; five agent fixes since (RS-463/466/470/472/474) never reached it, and 1.380.1 still removes signed-in workers beyond the host count
location: worker@10.10.60.14 container rs-fleet-agent image ghcr.io/jinhuw/fleet-agent:1.380.1@sha256:fb02c2f3…ec74; apps/fleet-agent/src/plan.ts:242 at v1.380.1 vs plan.ts:253-256 at 62f53dec
failure_scenario: An operator lowers worker-60-14's capacity on prod's Fleet page, for example from 10 to 8 to free accounts. Agent 1.380.1 stops and removes rs-fleet-worker-60-14-9 and -10, throwing away two signed-in browsers. Raising the count later costs two fresh Facebook logins, each of which risks a checkpoint. The UI copy written for RS-463 tells the operator that hosts never remove a worker, so nothing warns them.

title: [cross-lane] 45% of fleet city searches on 10.10.60.14 end with 0 cards: Facebook answers 'No listings found within 40 miles' though the monitor asks for radius=100
location: worker@10.10.60.14 rs-fleet-worker-60-14-{1,3..10} logs (24h to 2026-10-31T20:15Z); vendored monitor search/retrieve in image aimm-recycle:0.15.0@sha256:462d29f2
failure_scenario: Each zero-card item still spends a task from the ~665/day search budget, which already trails ~972/day of demand after the 416-city catalog push. Nearly half the budget therefore buys nothing, and leads within 40-100 miles of the city are never searched. The radius filter is probably not applied, or the multi-word query is too narrow for the 40-mile default. The parse errors silently drop cards from pages that did load.

location: RemoteTrigger trig_01W3wmHwWNUGr63STjr9e5UT, env env_01LUc7Gka7hUDXMtor55tYnf, last run cse_01LBzvMzLrheVx4xnowf9c4X (2026-10-31T06:09Z)

title: Fleet host 10.10.60.14 is not scraped by Prometheus, so its down, disk and memory states never alert
failure_scenario: Each worker image is 2.59 GB and old tags are never pruned (13.1 GB reclaimable today). With more releases, or a hung host, / fills or the box drops off the network and Telegram stays silent. The fleet then loses 9 workers' capacity until someone notices on the ERP page.

title: Secrets backup trackers/reddit/scripts/secrets.env.bak-20261022-192641 sits untracked and not gitignored in the main checkout
